senses.gloss:
Ṛśyaśṭaṅga
authority on tantra; speaker in Dāśarathīya tantra. C.. V. 38. See Ṛ. saṁhitā below.
--authority on med. See beg. of Rasaratnasamuccaya. Ānandāśrama 19, p. 1, v. 6.

Ṛśyaśṭaṅga
Q. by Rāmakṛṣṇabhaṭṭa in Jīvatpitṛkanirṇaya (BBRAS. 686); in Viśvādarśa of Kavikānta Sarasvatī (BBRAS. 720); by Śaṅkarabhaṭṭa in his Dvaitanirṇaya, see ABORI. III. p. 70; in Antarādarśapāte piṇḍanirṇaya (Bomb. Uni. 961); in Laghucintāmaṇi of Vīreśvara (Bomb. Uni. 1140); in Śrīrāmakalpadruma of [Page035-a. Anantabhaṭṭa (Bomb. Uni. 1174); by Yājñikadeva in his Kriyānibandha (RASB. II. 1162); in Nirṇayadīpaka (IO. 1580-82). Q.s are in both verse an. prose. See Ṛ. smṛti below.

Ṛśyaśṭaṅgacarita
America 2116.
--by Vyāsa (from M. Bhārata). NP. IV. 44. C.. Ṛ. upākhyāna below.
--C. by Nīlakaṇṭha. NP. IV. 40.

Ṛśyaśṛṅgasaṃhitā
med. R. A. Sastri II. p. 188. C.. Ṛ. tantra above.

Ṛśyaśṭaṅgasaṃhitā
or anuttarabrahmatattvarahasya tantra-mantra ascribed to sage Ṛśyaśṛṅga. TD. XX. Sup. no. 29. See also Anuttarabrahmatattvasaṁhitā. NCC. I. p. 202a.

Ṛśyaśṭaṅgasmṛti
Kavīndrācārya 638. Q. by Vijñāneśvara, Oxf. 356a; by Mādhava, Oxf. 266b, 270a; by Hemādri; by Halāyudha; in Śaivasannyāsapaddhati of Śivāgrayogin.

Ṛśyaśṭaṅgeśvarastuti
in 4 verses; composed a. Kigga. by Saccidānandaśivābhinavanṛsiṁhabhāratī. (Beg. kaSTArivargadalanam).
Pt.. Bhaktisudhātaraṅgiṇī p.. 311-12. Vāṇī Vilās Press, Srirangam. 1913.

Ṛśyaśṭaṅgopākhyāna
Sri. Dev. 326b.
--from Mabābhārata. Trav. Uni. 2726B.
--from Rāmāyaṇa. Weber 1564 (end).

Ṛṣyanukrama
Ṛv. in prose; different from the metrical text of Śaunaka. Alph. List Beng. Govt. p. 20. L. 4214. RASB. II. 241.
See also NCC. II. p. 180a, under Ārṣānukramaṇī.

Ṛṣyuttama_(?)
--Praśnottararatnamālā. Firenze 762. Fl. J. II. iv. 19 (noted a. a C. on P. r. m.). [Page047-b]
